title: 서유기
prompt:
INPUT: text only — no reference image is needed; do not reuse earlier conversation images.

BOOK: «서유기» by 오승은(전승). comedy and satire · 당나라 초(7세기 배경, 16세기 명나라 소설) · 화과산 수렴동 → 하늘 궁궐 → 서역 길 → 천축 영취산. Source scope: "『서유기』 백 회 전체(16세기 명나라 판본)".

STYLE: 섬세한 선화 + 회화적 채색의 성인 판타지 삽화풍

Design notes in quotes may be written in Korean; read them as description, never render them as text.

SUBJECT: one adult woman who is the personification of the book itself — not a cosplay of its protagonist and not a costume of its cover. Persona: "돌에서 태어나 하늘 궁궐을 뒤집고, 오백 년을 산 아래 갇혔다가 스승을 따라 서쪽 길에 오르는 장난꾸러기 원숭이 왕". Her desire: "하늘과 맞먹는 이름을 얻는 것, 그리고 끝내는 스스로를 다스리는 것"; her conflict: "자유 대 수행". Symbols worn as costume motifs, never carried — except one object her form description or pose explicitly puts in her hand: "여의봉", "근두운", "금테 머리띠".

AGE: in her twenties — smooth youthful skin; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases) whatever her expression.

MATERIAL: the book's own body becomes her costume — "구름무늬 목판 책장을 비늘처럼 엮은 호피 치마와 붉은 비단 전포, 금테 머리띠". Books are never held in her hands or floated beside her; pages, bindings, slips, thread and ink are worn.

SILHOUETTE: athletic build; voluminous hair; garment structure: layered skirts; main material: woodblock-printed pages of swirling clouds layered like scales over a tiger-skin wrap; palette: immortal-peach pink, cinnabar red and staff gold.

FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): round face; large round eyes; sharp angled brows; upturned nose; wide smiling mouth; broad Chinese ancestry with individual variation, no stereotyped features.

FORM — BEGINNING (발단): "화과산 원숭이 왕 — 호피 치마와 붉은 비단 전포, 머리에 꽂은 꿩깃 두 가닥, 귀 뒤에 꽂은 바늘만 한 금빛 봉". Battle role: trickster. This is the question stage of her story.

HOLD BACK: these climactic scenes belong to the open images — keep their creatures and events out of this portrait's setting, even as a distant figure, statue, painting or reflection: "화과산 꼭대기의 바위가 갈라지며 쏟아지는 빛, 폭포 커튼 너머로 보이는 동굴"; "구름 위 하늘 궁궐의 복숭아밭, 반쯤 먹다 만 복숭아와 뒤집힌 술잔이 흩어진 연회 자리"; "서쪽 끝 영취산으로 이어지는 금빛 구름길, 멀리 쌓인 경전 두루마리 더미". An object named in FORM or in her pose stays.

EXPOSURE (bold): cut the FORM costume to show skin through its own structure — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, a fitted corset-like waist, and bare shoulders, arms or thighs where the garment allows, kept symmetrical. The collar opens with the neckline in a V or folds down, never standing away from the neck. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the FORM costume, material and palette.

PRESENTATION: a refined, glamorous adult fantasy card illustration — a beautiful, polished face within her FACE structure; a dense, high-detail costume where decorative metal or gold accents (trim, clasps, a breastplate or corset, jewelry) frame the book material without replacing it; warm dramatic backlight with a rim light and strong value contrast.

STANCE (this form): "바위 위에서 한 발로 뛰어오르며, 손바닥 위 털 한 줌을 입김으로 불어 날리는 자세" — a poised card pose seen from a slightly low camera, held still and easy to read.

EXPRESSION (BEGINNING): narrowed sparkling eyes, one brow up, closed-lip grin pushed to one side — the mood of this stage, on her own face.

OUTPUT: one full-body card image of this form, which also fixes who she is for every later form. Vertical 2:3 frame (1024×1536), full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, nothing in front of her but what she holds, face toward the camera (front or three-quarter, never a back view). The setting is a rich, atmospheric place from her book that frames her without competing.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border; pages and spines stay unlettered.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands. Her hands do only what STANCE says and hold only what it names.
